results.title: Stock Market Today (May 6, 2026): Dow futures rise on hopes for U.S.-Iran deal
results.summary: Stock futures climbing and oil prices falling on hopes for an agreement to end the U.S.-Iran conflict. S&P 500 rose 0.81% on May 5 to 7,259.22 (record). Nasdaq gained 1.03% to 25,326.13 (record). Dow added 356.35 pts to 49,298.25. Tech best sector, up over 2%. WTI crude dipped 3.9% to $102.27/bbl.
